items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Is that not where Bing Crosby and the trio that he was singing with once worked? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't think so.

ctx.x: Of course that job didn't last, he didn't make it go and so Leon didn't have much work and so the last job I had with him was on New Year's Eve, 1928/ After that I didn't play with him anymore because he didn't have any work.
Mr. Blakeney, tell us a little bit about the Sebastian Cotton
Club; Frank Sebastian, I think, is very significant.
